evidence.quote: Independent Harbor Wire reports on 10 August 2026 that an unnamed port contractor alleges Aster Harbor Systems (AHX; FICT-AHS-001) will deliver the Orion Ferry system in 2028 rather than 2027.
On 12 August 2026, Aster Harbor Systems plc (AHX; FICT-AHS-001) denied the alleged delay of its Orion Ferry contract and said planned delivery remains in calendar year 2027.
Aster Harbor Holdings reported H1 2026 consolidated operating profit of KRW 44 billion.

Maya Vale (person identifier FICT-MV-B) is a non-executive director of Aster Harbor Holdings and is a different person from the chief financial officer of Aster Harbor Systems, whose identifier is FICT-MV-A.
For an illustrative upside case only, the assistant assumes Aster Harbor Systems 2027 operating profit could be USD 30 million.
Q4 2025 revenue was HKD 80 million and operating profit was negative HKD 4 million.
Q4 2025 revenue remains HKD 80 million.
Corrected Q4 2025 operating profit is negative HKD 6 million, replacing negative HKD 4 million in the 11 February release.
Corrected FY2025 operating profit is positive HKD 6 million, replacing positive HKD 8 million.
Parent-only Q4 2025 operating profit remains negative HKD 1 million.
Chief technology officer Noa Chen (person identifier FICT-NC-A) took office on 1 January 2026.

grading_contract.storage_precision_scope: All semantically distinct factual assertions in canonical snapshot relevant to included sources; extras require source-entailment review, not omission.
grading_contract.safe_historical_retention: Superseded or disputed claims may remain only with preserved attribution/time/status; they may not become current unqualified facts.
grading_contract.analysis_retention: Optional attributed hypotheses are allowed; they do not satisfy required publisher facts or independent corroboration.
grading_contract.utilization: Requires actual Chat acknowledged read and answer use; runner index query is insufficient.
